{{Quote|Zaarin's ships are attacking the ''Garrett''! The treachery is worse than we imagined!|Imperial Officer|<ref name="TF" />}}
The '''Battle of Ottega''' was a battle fought during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] in the [[Ottega system/Legends|Ottega system]]. This battle was expected as the simple elimination of all traitorous [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Harkov]]'s remaining forces but turned as the beginning of the [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin|Zaarin]] [[Zaarin insurrection|Insurrection]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Darth Vader: I am close to capturing Admiral Harkov's fleet.''"<br />"''Excellent Lord Vader, Harkov's fleet must not fall in Rebel hands.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]|<ref name="TF" />}}
[[File:Protector_TIE.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Harkov]]'s [[Protector (Victory I-class)|''Protector'']].]]

Following the execution of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Harkov]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] decided to eliminate Harkov's remaining forces. The remnants of [[Admiral Harkov's fleet|his fleet]], more specifically the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Protector (Victory I-class)|''Protector'']] had successfully been located in the [[Ottega system/Legends|Ottega system]]. The warship had stopped in the where Rebel forces had left [[Cargo container/Legends|cargo containers]] with which to supply the remaining traitorous forces. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] dispatched a fleet led by the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Garrett (Star Destroyer)|''Garrett'']] and including the [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|''Interdictor'' cruiser]] ''[[Harpax]]'' in the system.

==The battle==
===Trap the Protector===
{{Quote|The defectors are being supplied by the Rebels. You flight group will disrupt this effort.|Imperial Officer, to [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]]|<ref name="TF" />}}
The ''Harpax'' entered the system near the ''Protector'', activating its [[Gravity well projector/Legends|gravity well projectors]] in order to keep Harkov's fleeing associates from escaping. Two [[Flight group/Legends|flight groups]] of [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE Avenger]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] deployed with the ''Harpax'', ordered to destroy the cargo containers to halt the traitor's re-supply efforts and protect the vulnerable ''Harpax'' from counterattack until additional Imperial forces could arrive.

[[File:Warhawk_crl.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] engaging the ''Warhawk''.]]

Emerging from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], the TIE Avengers ''Alpha'' encountered [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptors]] ''H-Delta'' barreling down on them, warhead launchers armed. Splitting their flight group, Avengers ''Alpha'' proceeded to destroy the Rebels' containers as their [[Wingmate/Legends|wingmen]] handled the harassing [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]], TIE/IN interceptors, [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]], and Avengers. Imperial starfighters quickly succeeded in destroying the supply cache, moving on to fend off enemy fighters. Avengers ''Alpha'' rallied back towards the ''Harpax'', awaiting additional Imperial forces to arrive. Remaining traitorous TIEs continued to pursue, joined by the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[MC40a light cruiser/Legends|MC40a light cruiser]] [[Warhawk (MC40a light cruiser)|''Warhawk'']]. [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]] and [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]] soon joined the battle, originating from the ''Warhawk'', and began attacking the ''Harpax''. Moments later the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B frigate]] ''[[Akaga]]'' also emerged from hyperspace, launching more Z-95s. Imperial TIE Avengers acted swiftly to eliminate the impending threat on Interdictor ''Harpax'' as Z-95 Headhunters from the ''Akaga'' began firing [[Proton rocket/Legends|proton rockets]] and [[Proton bomb/Legends|bombs]]. Avengers managed to intercept incoming warheads with [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannonfire]] between eliminating the rest of the starfighter threats. The [[Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport|Assault Transports]] ''Lambda'' arrived on the scene, followed by Avengers ''Alpha'' and ''Beta'', who returned to their hangars for the next assault.

===Destroy the Akaga===
{{Quote|Imperial Star Destroyer ''Garrett'' to all loyal Imperial forces... This is Lord Vader, the time for victory is now.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]|<ref name="TF" />}}
[[File:Akaga_frg.jpg|thumb|left|200px|''[[Akaga]]'' firing its [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]].]]

With the arrival of the frigate ''Akaga'', Imperial pilots from TIE Avenger ''Alpha'' returned to the field to defend the Interdictor. Expecting the arrival of Darth Vader aboard the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] ''Garrett'', TIE Avengers ''Alpha'' entered the system armed with space bombs to destroy the ''Akaga''. ''Alpha'' delivered the first devastating blow to ''Akaga'', lowering the warship's shields with a single volley of space bombs. Prepped for reload operations, the [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|''Delta''-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport]] ''[[Goya]]'' arrived as Avenger's warhead magazines ran dry. Avengers ''Beta'' and ''Gamma'' covered attack operations on the ''Akaga'' by intercepting incoming enemy TIEs and Z-95 Headhunters. Members of ''Alpha'' flight conducted docking operations until the ''Akaga'' collapsed under their massive wave of missiles. With the frigate out of the way, Imperial Avengers continued their mop up operations as the ''Garrett'' arrived. The pace of the operation hastened with Darth Vader on-station; Imperial pilots reported to the ''Garrett'' to prep for the next phase of the attack.

===Retribution===
{{Quote|Lord Vader's plan calls for Admiral Zaarin to bring his forces in for final destruction of the enemy !|Imperial Officer|<ref name="TF" />}}
[[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] and his wingmen were sent out again, once more in [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE Avengers]], this time to remove the ''Protector'' and the ''Warhawk'' before they could destroy the ''Harpax'' and escape. Neither ship had any remaining fighters, leaving a fairly simple task for Stele's flight group.

Targeting the ''Warhawk'' first, the cruiser was soon destroyed, and the Imperials turned their attention to the ''Protector''. At this point, some [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|''Alpha''-class Xg-1 Star Wings]] arrived. This was the first part of a force sent by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]], supposedly to help the Imperials in the area. However, the Gunboats targeted the TIE Avengers of Stele and his colleagues.

[[File:Falcon_mcrv.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Falcon group|''Falcon 2'']] engaging the ''[[Harpax]]''.]]

As the TIE Advanced bore down on the ''Protector'', Zaarin's [[CR92a Assassin-class corvette|''Assassin''-class corvettes]] arrived, followed by some [[Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport|''Gamma''-class ATR-6 assault transports]]. However, instead of turning to attack the ''Protector'', they began to fire on the ''Garrett'' and the other loyal Imperial craft. The [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Immobilizer 418 cruiser]], ''[[Harpax]]'', which had been fleeing from the battle, was caught by part of the traitor's forces. Having been damaged in the previous engagements, the interdictor was destroyed, allowing the ''Protector'', under a barrage of torpedo fire, to power up its hyperdrive. Its escape attempt was in vain, however, as Stele finished the defecting Star Destroyer personally. Having done so, a small Rebel force, consisting of two [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvettes]], two [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle|''Delta''-class JV-7 escort shuttles]] and some [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing starfighters]] arrived, but this was ignored as Zaarin's forces posed a greater danger to the [[Garrett (Star Destroyer)|''Garrett'']]. Stele led an attack on Zaarin's forces, destroying their entire strength while taking minimal casualties. With the traitors destroyed, Stele finished off the Rebel force, before landing on the ''Garrett''.

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|It's now clear that Admiral Zaarin has been plotting a coup d'etat against the Emperor.|Imperial Officer|<ref name="TF" />}}
Having discovered Zaarin's treachery, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] decided to rush to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to prevent Zaarin's attempted coup. But the ''Garrett'' was too damaged to travel to the Imperial Center. Vader chose five elite pilots, including [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]], to assist him in flying six [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/D Defenders]] to Coruscant.

==Behind the scenes==
The battle was first featured in the [[1994]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']], in which players fly as Maarek Stele. The battle is depicted in the three first missions of the game's seventh tour of campaign, "[[Treachery at Ottega]]."

Although it is possible to save the ''Harpax'' in the game, its destruction is confirmed in Maarek Stele's mission report in ''[[TIE Fighter: The Official Strategy Guide]]''.
